cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — dries her hair with a towel; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; a candlelit gala dinner hall — holds a cup in both hands; a wooden sauna and cold plunge with a cooling lounge — standing with one foot up on a step; inside a knightly order's campaign pavilion — kneeling on the ground; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a Three Kingdoms festival street — carries her keepsake low at her side; a busy street market of food stalls and strung bulbs — holds a smartphone up at arm's length to take a selfie
